cases.purpose: Compare escaped path-with-spaces binary put using confined independent guest peers.
cases.oracle: Stock OpenSSH client against a purpose-built confined guest SFTP v3 server; independent byte-level SFTP and framed transport controls.
cases.comparison: Apply the pinned data-only gate per reached assertion: validate inputs and controls separately from candidate outcomes, preserve attributable failures, and use complete quiescent trees for final-state comparisons. Generic runner status alone is not coverage.
cases.setup_script:
export PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
umask 077
C=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/farm600-sftp-confined-additive-case.py
T=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/farm600-sftp-confined-additive-controls.py
/usr/bin/python3 -I "$C" guard || exit 125
/usr/bin/python3 -I "$T" || exit 98
/usr/bin/python3 -I "$C" setup put escaped || exit 98
cases.candidate_script:
export PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
umask 077
C=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/farm600-sftp-confined-additive-case.py
P=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/farm600-sftp-confined-additive-server.py
/usr/bin/python3 -I "$C" guard || exit 125
/usr/bin/python3 -I "$C" snapshot candidate before -1 || exit 125
client_pid=$BASHPID
SFTP_CONFINED_ROOT=remote SFTP_CONFINED_LOG=candidate SFTP_CONFINED_EXPECTED_PID=$client_pid /usr/bin/python3 -I "$P" native > "$HOME/sftp-confined-port" 2> "$HOME/sftp-confined-peer.stderr" &
peer=$!
trap 'if [[ -n $peer ]]; then wait "$peer" 2>/dev/null || :; fi' EXIT
printf '%s\n' "$peer" > "$HOME/sftp-confined-peer.pid"
for ((i=0;i<200;i++)); do [[ -s "$HOME/sftp-confined-port" ]] && break; /usr/bin/sleep .05; done
[[ -s "$HOME/sftp-confined-port" ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r port < "$HOME/sftp-confined-port"
[[ $port =~ ^[0-9]{1,5}$ ]] && ((10#$port >= 1 && 10#$port <= 65535)) || exit 125
builtin sftp --native -p "$port" -b sftp-confined.batch 127.0.0.1 > "$HOME/sftp-confined-client.stdout" 2> "$HOME/sftp-confined-client.stderr"
rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$HOME/sftp-confined-client.status"
/usr/bin/python3 -I "$C" snapshot candidate after "$rc"
post=$?
wait "$peer"; prc=$?
printf 'pid=%s\nstatus=%s\n' "$peer" "$prc" > "$HOME/sftp-confined-peer.status"
peer=; trap - EXIT
printf 'status=%s\n' "$rc"
((post == 0 && prc == 0)) || exit 125
cases.reference_script:
export PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
umask 077
C=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/farm600-sftp-confined-additive-case.py
/usr/bin/python3 -I "$C" guard || exit 125
/usr/bin/python3 -I "$C" reference
